messages:
Ana: heads up — getting multiple reports from SDR that HubSpot webhook retries are spiking during big webinar signups. leads stuck in 'pending' for >30m. anyone seen this pattern before?
Sam: yep saw a brief surge this morning, webhook timeouts -> retries cascade. looks like our ingest lambda is being slammed and the RR assigner queues up.
Micah: re: SLAs — we currently consider a lead 'handed' once assignment job ACKs, but if webhook retries delay ingestion it's outside that window. we should probably move to a two-stage SLA: ingest ACK + owner-assigned.
Raj: agreed. short term: add exponential backoff / jitter on HS side to reduce thundering herd. long term: add an ingest queue with a fast path for VIP leads.
Ana: can we add a property on HS (redwood_ingest_status) that gets set to 'received' immediately, then assignment happens asynchronously? that helps owners see backlog.
Sam: yes — we can set a workflow to set redwood_ingest_status = received in the webhook workflow. then our processor can transition to 'assigned' once RR completes.
Micah: also propose adding a heartbeat metric: lead.ingest.latency.p50/p95 to Datadog, and an alert if >1m for p95 during business hours.
Raj: +1. I'll sketch patch for RR assigner so it respects a configurable concurrency cap and fast-fails to fallback pool when backlog > X.
Ana: fallback pool = what we currently call 'overflow-sdr' right? make sure enrichment still runs before owner assignment if enrichment latency < 2m.
Sam: spelling out quick playbook for ops: 1) if webhook retry rate > 10/min : toggle HS backoff workflow (toggle flag) 2) scale ingest workers by +2 3) mark high-priority webinar leads with tag 'webinar_vip' to route to fast-path
Micah: adding to that — for Salesforce connector, ensure idempotency key is included: `X-Redwood-Lead-ID` header. currently some retries create dup attempts.
Raj: small config snippet for exponential backoff we can push to HS webhook retry policy: ```{"retry": {"attempts": 5, "base_delay_ms": 500, "multiplier": 2, "jitter": 0.2}}```
Ana: thanks. owners: Raj will do RR caps + fallback pool, Sam will add ingest flag & HS workflow, Micah will wire alerts, I'll communicate quick guidance to SDRs. target: have short-term toggles ready before next webinar tomorrow at 10am PT.
Sam: deploying HS workflow toggle as feature flag now, will post deploy-bot notice.
deploy-bot: deploy started for feature/redwood/hs-ingest-flag — 3 containers, canary 10% -> 100% in 5m.
Raj: will open PR for RR concurrency cap and fallback routing, assign to @Sam for review.
Ana: great — once PRs merged can we run a tabletop runbook at 9am PT? want SDR ops on the line so they know when to flip flag.
Micah: yep, I'll schedule 9-9:15am and include the Datadog playbook link.
Ana: perfect. thanks all :thumbsup:
